title: Holi 2026 Travel Alert: Indian Railways Announces 18 Special Trains - Check Full List & Dates
text:
New Delhi, India ‚Äî February 19, 2026
The Indian Railways has announced 18 special trains (9 pairs) for the Holi festival season to manage heavy passenger demand across major travel routes. The additional services will operate between February 22 and March 30, 2026, aiming to ease congestion and improve ticket availability during one of the busiest travel periods of the year.
Every year, train waiting lists surge ahead of Holi as millions travel to their hometowns, especially on routes connecting Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Gujarat, Delhi, and Odisha.
üöâ Purpose of Special Trains
Railway officials said the extra trains are intended to:
Reduce festive crowding
Increase confirmed ticket availability
Improve passenger safety and convenience
